title: Fix Admin link visibility in header navigation

requirements.summary: Debug and fix the Header component to ensure the Admin navigation link is visible and clickable in the header navigation menu
acceptanceCriteria: Admin link is visible in the header navigation menu alongside the Products link
Admin link navigates to /admin route when clicked
Admin link styling is consistent with other navigation links in the header

file_operations.description: Review and fix the navigation section to ensure the Admin Link component is rendered without conditional hiding. Verify the Link component has the correct 'to' prop pointing to /admin and is styled consistently with other navigation links. Ensure the Admin link appears alongside the Products link in the header navigation menu.

requirements.summary: Verify that the Link component for Admin in Header.tsx has correct routing configuration and is not conditionally hidden
acceptanceCriteria: Admin Link component exists in the Header component JSX
Admin Link has correct 'to' prop pointing to /admin route
No conditional rendering logic is hiding the Admin link from users

file_operations.description: Inspect the Admin Link component to confirm it exists in the JSX structure, has the correct 'to="/admin"' prop, and is not wrapped in any conditional rendering logic (such as user authentication checks or display:none styles) that would prevent it from being visible to all users.
